data.spec: User authorizes parallel implementation of deterministic sensor→action mapping. One integration owner in deterministic-facility-rules task; engine, UI independent. New additive /api/facility: GET {rules:FacilityRule[],incidents:FacilityIncident[],readings:FacilityReading[],evaluated_at:string}; POST /api/facility/rules/:id with complete FacilityRule validates/persists configuration; POST /api/facility/readings FacilityReading {event_id,board_id,metric,value,timestamp,simulation:boolean} → {duplicate:boolean,incidents:FacilityIncident[]}; POST /api/facility/incidents/:id/acknowledge. Rule fields {id,title,board_id,metric,enabled,direction:'above'|'below'|'stale',trigger_value,reset_value,min_samples,min_duration_seconds,max_gap_seconds,actions:('alert'|'ticket'|'replenish'|'sound')[],severity:'routine'|'urgent'|'critical',item_id:string|null,summary}. Metrics co2_ppm|temperature_c|humidity_pct|stock_level|bin_fill_pct|obstruction_mm|noise_level|tilt_deg|heartbeat. Incident {id,rule_id,board_id,title,summary,severity,status:'active'|'recovered',value,simulation,opened_at,recovered_at:null|string,acknowledged_at:null|string,actions:action[],action_results:object}. Persistent debounce/hysteresis/latch/idempotency; deterministic replenishment uses approved product/planning+exact approval without model interpretation. Sound browser-only with explicit Enable sound gesture, one chime per new active incident; hardware sound unverified. Existing routes unchanged except /api/sensor feeds shared evaluator for known metric aliases; skip legacy threshold trigger if a facility rule owns same metric. New files isolated; minimal api.py and App.tsx integration by task owner. Another owner is preparing twin/Python merge; additive facility files may finish after snapshot, preserve them.
